description: UK exam calendar dates verified against JCQ and the exam boards' own documents: results days (A-level 12 August 2027, GCSE 19 August 2027, November 2026 GCSE resits 13 January 2027, Scotland 10 August 2027), the summer 2027 exam timetable (JCQ common window 10 May – 22 June, contingency day 23 June 2027; per board — AQA, Pearson Edexcel, Cambridge OCR and WJEC/Eduqas, all final — the dates of GCSE Maths papers 1–3, English Language papers 1–2, Combined Science papers and A-level Maths papers), entry deadlines (JCQ 21 February 2027) with each board's late and very-late entry fee dates and multipliers, and announced specification changes (first-teaching and first-exam years, DfE reform timetable, Ofqual decisions). Input kind (results, timetable, deadlines, spec-changes; omitted → the listing), optional board (jcq, aqa, pearson/edexcel, ocr, wjec/eduqas, sqa, ofqual, dfe) and qualification (gcse, a-level). Every figure carries its source document, the quoted timetable row, verifiedDate (2026-10-04) and, where the board's 2026 document is still served, the summer-2026 date as previous. An unknown kind, board or qualification answers covered:false with the nearest keys.

board.description: optional: jcq (common dates), aqa, pearson (edexcel), ocr (cambridge), wjec-eduqas (wjec, eduqas), sqa (Scotland), ofqual, dfe

kind.description: one of: results, timetable, deadlines, spec-changes (omit to list all)

qualification.description: optional: gcse or a-level (figures common to both are returned for either)
